subject.title: fix(logging): keep JSON console output structured across CLI routes

question: Should this PR intentionally make previously plain early-startup and diagnostic records become JSON envelopes whenever an existing user has selected `logging.consoleStyle: "json"`?
rationale: The change is the reported contract repair and is scoped to an explicit configuration opt-in, but it still changes the parser-visible shape of records for existing operator pipelines; the protected maintainer label requires an explicit owner decision.

options.title: Accept the JSONL contract correction
options.body: Land the patch with the documented expectation that JSON console style produces structured records on the repaired paths.

options.title: Narrow the repair boundary
options.body: Keep the core capture fix but exclude any diagnostic path whose legacy plain format must remain stable for operator tooling.

options.title: Pause for logging-contract review
options.body: Defer the PR until maintainers define whether JSON console style promises all console diagnostics or only logger-originated records.

recommendation.title: Accept the JSONL contract correction
recommendation.body: Land the patch with the documented expectation that JSON console style produces structured records on the repaired paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to this PR and authored the integration that determines the repaired logging boundary.
